description:
Paris, 1896: A Morning Forgotten by Time
It is a crisp morning in 1896, and the sun is just beginning to catch the stone facades of a Paris that still smells of horses and coal. We are standing on a cobblestone street, and for a few seconds, the rush of the modern world feels like a distant dream.

The Urban Symphony
The silence of the morning is broken by the unmistakable metallic hum of the Tramway 109. It moves with a heavy, steady grace, its crimson paint standing out against the muted greys of the city. Notice the passengers inside—shadows of people heading to work, perhaps to a café or a shop, completely unaware that their mundane commute would one day become a window into a vanished century.


Music: Claude Debussy, La plus que lente.
